items.claim: xychart value axis flips when only one end is set past the data
insertPacketField accepts a field that overlaps the one before it
items.note: I made the strict call (it throws, as `setPacketStart` does) and recorded it in `docs/unruled.md`.

items.claim: an xychart series object listed twice draws both copies in one bar slot
sankey layout is quadratic in nodes × links
items.note: There's no failing-first test, since a timing test would be flaky. The existing sankey tests pass, and a local benchmark (5,400 nodes, 10,400 links) produced identical output in 3.4–7.2 s before and 34–35 ms after. That figure is from this machine, not the fleet.

items.claim: sankey's typed flow accepts hex, binary, and octal; pie's rejects them
items.note: Both now read through one shared decimal reader, `typedAmountOf`.

items.claim: xychart row edits pad short series with zeros, so missing points get drawn
items.note: This was a behavior call, because the old test asserted the zero padding. A missing value now stays missing (written as `NaN`, drawn as no point), and an inserted row is a zero only in series that reach it. `setXyValue` had the same padding and is fixed in the same commit. Recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.

items.claim: an xychart drag runs a value past a set value-axis end
items.note: `xyValueAt` gains an optional third argument (the value axis), so it has two changesets: patch for the fix, minor for the API.

items.claim: radar's rim flips when `max` is set at or below zero with no `min` (sweep, the same mistake as the xychart one)
